newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes on Wednesday rocketed suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets in south Lebanon's highlands, Lebanese security sources said.
They said the jets fired four rockets on hills in the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge, a bastion of the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God).
It was not immediately known if there were any casualties in the air attack, the third on south Lebanon in less than a week.
Last Thursday, Hizbollah killed two Israeli soldiers and wounded eight inside the Jewish state's 15-km (nine miles)-deep occupation zone.
